new_findings.what: vLLM 0.28 AOT compile-cache invalidation gap: envs.compile_factors() + VllmConfig.compute_hash() + _model_hash_key(forward) form the artifact dir key, and caching._verify_source_unchanged only re-checks the TRACED files recorded inside the EXISTING artifact. A kernel-selection patch (swap which linear/MoE kernel is chosen, changing weight layout/dtype) touches files that were NEVER in the traced set, so the stale artifact still verifies and is silently replayed -> wrong-shape assert_size_stride in profile_run even though the eager path is correct. Kernel-enablement patches therefore REQUIRE a cold compile.

summary: Diagnosed the CURRENT (deeper) boot failure as a stale vLLM torch.compile AOT cache, NOT a new code gap. The kept FP8-emulation patch (001) edits only UNTRACED files (kernel registry __init__.py + new scaled_mm/emulation.py), so vllm/compilation/caching.py keeps the same cache key and reloads the pre-patch artifact (torch_aot_compile/63eba2e.../rank_*_0/model, mtime 15:13, built for FP8 [K,N] aten._scaled_mm). Replaying that graph against the now-BF16 [N,K] dequantized weight dies in profile_run: assert_size_stride arg10_1 (4096,2560)/(1,4096) vs actual (2560,4096)/(4096,1). VERIFIED ON MY CARDS: booting the 001-patched tree with a fresh compile cache clears profile_run, allocates KV cache, captures CUDA graphs, and serves coherent tokens (17*23->391; correct 'sky is blue' reasoning). Authored patch 002 to make this structural: it folds a digest of model_executor/kernels + layers/quantization + layers/fused_moe/oracle into aot_compile_hash_factors so any kernel-selection patch invalidates the cache and forces a correct recompile. This is expected to clear the gap to FULL runnability for Ornith-1.5-397B-FP8 / vllm / MI250X.
